parameters.query:
WITH booking_info AS (
    SELECT id, recurring_series_id
    FROM bookings.confirmed_bookings
    WHERE id = $2::uuid AND tenant_id = $3
    FOR UPDATE
),
series_update AS (
    UPDATE bookings.recurring_series
    SET balance_due  = GREATEST(0, balance_due - $1::numeric),
        updated_at   = NOW()
    WHERE id = (SELECT recurring_series_id FROM booking_info WHERE recurring_series_id IS NOT NULL)
      AND tenant_id = $3
    RETURNING balance_due
),
booking_update AS (
    UPDATE bookings.confirmed_bookings
    SET balance_due  = GREATEST(0, balance_due - $1::numeric),
        deposit_paid = deposit_paid + $1::numeric,
        updated_at   = NOW()
    WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM booking_info WHERE recurring_series_id IS NULL)
      AND tenant_id = $3
    RETURNING balance_due
)
SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT balance_due FROM series_update),
    (SELECT balance_due FROM booking_update),
    0
) AS balance_due,
(SELECT recurring_series_id IS NOT NULL FROM booking_info) AS is_recurring;

'partial' : 'full',  amount: $('Code: Sanitize').first().json.amount}) }}

parameters.query:
SELECT c.full_name, c.email, c.phone,
  COALESCE(cb.date_from, cb.booking_date) as event_date,
  cb.date_to, cb.start_time, cb.end_time,
  cb.total_amount, cb.balance_due, cb.deposit_paid,
  r.name as room_name
FROM bookings.customers c
JOIN bookings.confirmed_bookings cb ON cb.customer_id = c.id
JOIN bookings.rooms r ON cb.room_id = r.id
WHERE cb.id = $1 AND c.tenant_id = $2
LIMIT 1;
UPDATE bookings.confirmed_bookings SET status = 'fully_paid' WHERE id = $1 AND tenant_id = $2 RETURNING *;

INSERT INTO bookings.customer_interactions (
  tenant_id, customer_id, customer_name, customer_email, customer_phone,
  booking_id, room_name, subject, interaction_type, notes, staff_member, timestamp
)
SELECT
  $1::integer,
  c.id,
  $3, $4, $5,
  cb.id,
  $6,
  'Payment received: £' || $7 || ' | ' || COALESCE($6, ''),
  'payment_received',
  'Method: ' || $8 || ' | Ref: ' || $9,
  'System', NOW()
FROM bookings.confirmed_bookings cb
JOIN bookings.customers c ON c.id = cb.customer_id
WHERE cb.id = NULLIF($2, '')::uuid
  AND cb.tenant_id = $1::integer
LIMIT 1
RETURNING id;
